value.rationale: Complete natural recurrent-state and primitive-orbit counts are obtained for all cube dimensions and all finite characteristic-two fields. The exact structural mechanism isolates a single apex-induced rank-one square that doubles maximal temporal period for even dimensions but not for odd, with positive primitive populations in every listed class. This is not a selected-seed exercise or a known-table recomputation; it supplies an exact infinite-family graph-wave benchmark.
